title: Properties and Accessors
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of properties and accessors using at least one correct term from the lesson.
Interpret or adapt a small Kotlin example that demonstrates properties and accessors.
Identify one relevant edge case, debugging step, or version/platform constraint.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Properties and Accessors** as part of **Classes, Objects, and Object-Oriented Fundamentals**. Classes group state and behavior; primary constructors and properties keep ordinary domain models concise, while initialization order still matters. Use the subtopics—Properties Versus Fields, Custom Getters and Setters, Backing Fields—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: These concepts help you model domain rules and reusable APIs. Good boundaries reduce accidental mutation, unsafe casts, and code that is difficult to extend.
